manifest.notes: PLEA test run 8.5 on Sepolia (chain 11155111): the final code rehearsed once more, with a lighter default build (the test suite in test/full/). Run 7's code (testnet7 @ e1755aa, live as launch #1843: letters without the 0.35 IMD auto-sell fee, LetterTooLong(bytes, 280), the 1.2x seat multiplier read from Seasons' fourth argument with a gas-capped staticcall, the owner's 0.75% fee (2.0% in all), the 15-day cap ratchet, PleaDistributor Ownable2Step) plus IMD's run-7 CabalGate size refactor, the two fixes of run 7's launch audit (the Letterbox delivery floor after the hook's 2% sale fees; Tribunal.standing checks the seller's exclusion first), the fixes of audit rounds 5-8 (exact profit band edges; a second objector from another wallet may file while the first objection is pending; PleaLaunch checks the Letterbox's oracle fee settings and hash, and seed waits for the Letterbox and the Tribunal; Tribunal.status counts the seat multiplier; a plea larger than the buy record takes the PLEA-weighted mean of the record's and the received-PLEA facts, to the nearest point; the text checks refuse every Unicode format, variation-selector and default-ignorable character; PLEA a trim cannot take before the seller settles is burned from claims at rebalance; a buy's fee refund comes after its payouts; a Stacker without code falls back to plain-IMD cashback; the seed's dust burn is counted) and the run-8 numbers: the need is recalibrated: the fact score is 0-45 (share of the balance sold at most 20%: 16, at most 35%: 9, more: 3; held 7 days: 7, 3 days: 4, 1 day: 2; at a loss: 13, gain at most 50%: 12, 200%: 10, 500%: 8, 1,000%: 6, more: 4; PLEA no buy record covers: held since trading opened, profit 10; 24h trend up: 9, flat: 5, down: 0), the need is 71 minus the fact score (CannotPass above 45), the judges' 0-45 scale and definitions are unchanged, and a letter pleads 20% of the writer's PLEA. Deploy exactly PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in the listed order, with zero ETH, in one atomic factory transaction. PLEA and PleaDistributor receive $owner; PleaLaunch reads its owner from PLEA and registers the system during construction. Atomic deployment prevents another caller from taking PLEA's deployment-block registration window. CabalGate's arguments specify Intake v2, the oracle fee asset, pool TestIMD, the attestation signer, 18000-second seasons and a 118800-second dead-man. Seasons takes the same pool TestIMD and the seat NFT. PleaLaunch specifies the Sepolia v4 PoolManager, pool TestIMD, Stacker, credit gas 1300000, START 1792335600 (2026-10-18 15:00 UTC), and the same oracle fee asset. The static bool word 1 enables minting Sepolia's test oracle fee. PleaLaunch's 12th and 13th arguments are the keccak256 hashes of the accepted build's argument-free Letterbox and Tribunal creation code. The nonzero Tribunal commitment enables Objection!. Letterbox, Tribunal and PleaHook are present in the accepted source and deployed separately after this five-contract transaction through PleaLaunch's committed-code deployment functions; these are not manifest initialization calls. The hook requires a mined flag-compatible CREATE2 salt. Its deployment mints 82% of PLEA to the hook, 6% to Seasons and 12% to PleaDistributor. The distributor's owner sets one Merkle root for the swarm's 10% and the 2% airdrop. Seasons pays the top 25 eligible wallets with at least 60 points, using shareBps for both IMD and the 10000000 PLEA bonus in each of the first six seasons. Trading opens through seed() once the hook, the Letterbox and (the Tribunal hash being nonzero) the Tribunal are deployed: PLEA's owner may call any time; anyone may call from START. Neither seed nor the later deployments are part of this manifest's constructor-only launch.

jobs.objective: Launch PLEA test run 8.5 on Sepolia from this Foundry repository exactly as launch.json lists it: five contracts (PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor, PleaLaunch), deployed in order in one transaction with the constructor arguments in launch.json. This is the final code rehearsed once more (run 8's contracts and code hashes, with a lighter default build: the test suite moved to test/full/): run 7's code (branch testnet7 @ e1755aa, live as your launch #1843) plus (1) your run-7 adapt step's CabalGate size refactor, as delivered (no behaviour change); (2) the two Lows of run 7's launch audit, fixed: the Letterbox's 95% delivery floor is taken after the hook's 2% sale fees (HOOK_SALE_FEE_BPS 200), and Tribunal.standing checks the seller's exclusion before a pending objection; (3) the run-8 numbers: letters plead 20% (LETTER_SHARE_BPS 2000) and the fact score is 0-45: share of the balance sold at most 20%: 16, at most 35%: 9, more: 3; held 7 days: 7, 3 days: 4, 1 day: 2; at a loss: 13, gain at most 50%: 12, 200%: 10, 500%: 8, 1,000%: 6, more: 4 (exact band edges); PLEA that no buy record covers (claims, prizes) counts as held since trading opened, at profit 10; 24h trend up: 9, flat: 5, down: 0; need = 71 - fact (CannotPass above 45); (4) the fixes of your audit template's rounds 5 to 8 (audit/FINDINGS.md R5-* to R8-*; audit/rounds/5 to 8): two objections from different wallets may be pending at once (Tribunal Case.pending[2]); PleaLaunch's constructor refuses an oracle-fee setup the Letterbox would refuse and a zero or swapped Letterbox hash; seed waits for the hook, the Letterbox and the committed Tribunal; Tribunal.status counts the 1.2 seat multiplier; a plea larger than the seller's buy record takes the PLEA-weighted mean of the record's and the received-PLEA hold and profit points, to the nearest point; the gate's and the Tribunal's text checks refuse every Unicode format, variation-selector and default-ignorable character; PLEA the PoolManager cannot pay before a seller settles (a trim, the sale fee) is kept as ERC-6909 claims that rebalance burns; a partial fill's fee refund comes after the payouts; a Stacker without code falls back to plain-IMD cashback; the seed's dust burn is counted in totalBurned. Objection! (src/Tribunal.sol, spec OBJECTIONS.md; ownerless; deployed after the launch through PleaLaunch.deployTribunal(creationCode) against the keccak256 committed as PleaLaunch's 13th argument): for 20 minutes after an approval anyone except the seller and the wallets Seasons excludes may object (0.5 IMD oracle fee minted on Sepolia like the Letterbox's, a 0.35 IMD stake in pool IMD); a fresh panel re-scores the plea; sustained when newScore + 2 < need (no points, stake back), otherwise overruled (stake to the plea's season pot); no answer within 20 minutes voids it (stake back); the recorded score is the lowest any panel gave; at most two objections per plea, from different wallets; the sale is never touched and rulings never reset the dead-man. Unchanged from run 7: fees 2.0% (0.5% cashback, 0.75% owner, 0.25% prize pot, 0.25% wall, 0.25% of the PLEA burned), the 1.2 seat multiplier (Seasons' fourth argument, the IMD NFT (test) 0xa0443799c320e16c80801c9c1911f3571260287f), cap decay 15 days, the 82/6/12 split, six bonus seasons of 10,000,000 PLEA, top 25 from 450 to 350 bps. Build: a bare forge build compiles src, script and the launch-manifest suites in test/ (about 1 GB, under two minutes); a new test file goes in test/ and joins that build. The suite (823 tests in 89 suites) lives in test/full/ and the forks in test/fork/, both skipped by the default profile: run them with FOUNDRY_PROFILE=full forge test --match-path 'test/full/{A,B}.t.sol' a few files at a time (the forks skip without their RPC URL variables); never FOUNDRY_PROFILE=full forge build of the whole tree (several GB of memory, over a 10-minute limit); test/LaunchManifest.t.sol ties launch.json to both committed code hashes and asserts the launch fits the 16,777,216-gas cap with your factory's 22% headroom (13,494,931 as charged, 16,463,815 with headroom, 313,401 under). Audit the imported code and deploy it unchanged; fix only what the audit proves is a real bug, and keep every number as it is (timings, panel 30, quorum 17, 5-hour seasons, 33-hour dead-man, START 1792335600, credit gas 1300000, letters 20%, the fact table above, plea 1% to 50% or 2.5M, 0.70 IMD minimum plea value, 95% sale minimum, fee cap +10%, objection window 20 minutes, stake 0.35 IMD, margin 2, two objections per plea). If you change the Letterbox or the Tribunal, update its code hash in launch.json. Runtime sizes: PleaHook 24,402 bytes (174 under the EIP-170 limit), CabalGate 24,038, Letterbox 23,255, Tribunal 21,654, Seasons 12,473: keep any fix within them. Keep PLEA.setLauncher accepting either the deploy-transaction flag or PLEA's deployment block, and keep foundry.toml as it is, including the default profile's skip list, [lint] lint_on_build = false and the read-only fs_permissions for ./out and ./launch.json.
